title: Privileged session flow hardening: RBACv2, SAML assertions, and audit trail closure
creator: Anjali Rao
description: Scope: Close gaps identified in the recent third-party penetration test and internal threat modeling for privileged admin flows. Workstreams: (1) apply RBACv2 policy sanity checks and least-privilege mapping for admin and operator roles, (2) harden SAML assertion handling and session lifetime/refresh logic to prevent replay and impersonation, (3) extend audit logging to produce tamper-evident trails for admin primitives (role changes, token issuance, session revocations), and (4) provide remediation PRs, unit/integration tests, and follow-up validation with the pen-test vendor.
acceptance_criteria: RBACv2 policy engine rejects any role change that escalates privileges without explicit two-person approval flag
SAML assertion processing implements nonce and audience checks; test harness covers assertion replay scenarios
Audit logs capture admin primitives with consistent JSON schema, signed by log-forwarder and ingested into SIEM with preserved original event_id
Automated tests for session revocation ensure immediate token invalidation across hosted and Dedicated runtime lanes
PRs merged and e2e validation performed against pen-test re-run showing no critical findings for covered flows
steps_taken: Feb 22: Kickoff with Security, Identity, and Infra teams; aligned on scope and priority
Feb 25: Threat model updated — added attack vectors for SAML assertion replay and admin role chain-of-trust
Mar 02: Implemented RBACv2 policy pre-check hook (feature flag behind 'rbacv2-precheck') and wired unit tests
Mar 04: SAML handler patched to verify InResponseTo, AudienceRestriction, and strict time skew; added assertion nonce cache with TTL
Mar 06: Audit schema v2 drafted; landed forwarding agent change to attach log-signature header for tamper evidence
Mar 09: Internal integration test: session revocation exercised across Hosted API and Dedicated; observed propagation delay under 2s in staging
mitigation_plan: Short-term: enable rbacv2-precheck feature flag for dry-run on staging and capture false positives
Medium-term: require two-person approval for role assignments with scope 'org:admin' and above; add UI/Console guardrail
Long-term: introduce signed audit bundles in storage and retention policy; integrate with customer KMS for Private deployments
Contingency: fallback routing to read-only admin-tier model variant if policy engine becomes unavailable
test_results: Pen-test vendor report (Feb run): 1 critical (SAML replay), 2 high (privilege escalation via role chain), 3 medium. See linked report.
Post-fix internal tests: SAML replay scenarios blocked in 6/6 attempts; replay window reduced to configured TTL=30s
Privilege escalation test harness: policy pre-check prevented 89% of simulated escalations; remaining cases require schema updates (PR open)
Audit ingestion smoke: 100% of admin primitives emitted in expected schema; log-signature header validated by SIEM connector in staging

Mar 11 — Identity (Luca): "SAML nonce store implemented as in-memory cache; we should swap to Redis for cross-node consistency before release to Dedicated."
Mar 12 — Infra (Janelle): "Log-signature header introduced; will add rotation docs and KMS integration ticket (follow-up). Verified ingestion into SIEM in staging."
Mar 12 — Assignee (Marco): "Opening final PR to add Redis-backed nonce store and to convert pre-check dry-run to enforced in staging after smoke runs."
next_steps: Replace in-memory nonce cache with Redis-backed store (ENG-33605)
Complete UI two-person approval flow and add audit link to approval event (PM review required)
Coordinate pen-test vendor for targeted re-test of patched flows (schedule week of 2026-03-22)
Finalize migration plan for Private deployments KMS signing of audit bundles
postmortem_notes: If pen-test re-run surfaces regressions, we'll open targeted hotfix tickets by severity. The goal is to achieve zero criticals and no more than one high in the re-test. Lessons: treat SAML assertion replay as prioritised attack vector; prefer cross-node nonce stores for distributed runtime lanes.
audit_migration_plan: Schema v2 rollout: deploy forward-compatible producers for 2 weeks, enable SIEM ingest mapping, then switch consumers to v2. Provide runbook for manual verification and recovery.
owner_rotation: On-call rotation updated to include Security-Identity for 2-week window post-release
notes: This ticket consolidates multiple follow-ups from the Feb pen-test and internal threat modeling. Downstream tickets will track KMS integration, UI approval, and Private deployment validation.
